documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our equipment maintenance team requested discovery about spreadsheet coordination. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves conflicting project information regarding the requirement for spreadsheet coordination. The equipment maintenance team previously requested discovery about this, but the latest call indicates the project is paused and the owner disagrees with the requirement. This contradiction needs clarification before any further action.

claims.quote: Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that there is conflicting information regarding the project's status and the requirement for spreadsheet coordination. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current project status and whether the requirement for spreadsheet coordination remains valid? This will help us proceed effectively.
questions: Could you clarify the current status of the project and whether the requirement for spreadsheet coordination is still valid?
Is there any additional context or reason behind the project being paused?
uncertainties: The project status is paused, but the requirement for spreadsheet coordination is in question.
There is a disagreement between the equipment maintenance team and the project owner regarding the requirement.
